definitions.explanation: A desk designed for office work, typically with drawers for storing documents and stationery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{事務机|じむづくえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new office desk.

examples.japanese: {事務机|じむづくえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put the documents in the office desk drawer.

examples.japanese: ⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様替|もようが}え→模様替え：07708_moyougae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{事務机|じむづくえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: We decided to change the layout of the office desks as part of the office rearrangement.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard compound noun for a desk used in an office environment. Distinguished from desks used for studying or other purposes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務机|じむづくえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (on the office desk)
- {事務机|じむづくえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧ (to organize one's desk)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学習机|がくしゅうづくえ}→学習机：16663_gakushuuzukue⟧: study desk — a desk designed for students
- ⟦デスク→デスク：23405_desuku⟧: desk — the loanword used in modern office contexts
